impact: tests-ts/fixture-schema.test.mjs's CASES table is a fourth unverified description of part of the parity matrix, derived from nothing and already incomplete (omits all eight blocks_* modes and the combined-driven instances x codex_empty pair). Predates T-005 and is not touched by it; fixing it means deciding how the schema-validator tests relate to the case registry, which is a design question rather than a review fix. Filed as ISS-021.
resolution: Duplicate of ISS-021, which I filed manually for the same finding before also reporting it with disposition "deferred" — that auto-filed this second copy. My error, not a second defect. ISS-021 carries the fuller write-up (including why it is harmless today given ISS-002) and is the one to keep.
